newsitem.title: USA: Circuit Systems in talks to buy facility.
newsitem.headline: Circuit Systems in talks to buy facility.

text.p: Circuit Systems Inc said Thursday it had entered into negotiations to purchase the printed circuit board manufacturing operation of Philips Consumer Electronics Co, a division of North America Philips.
The purchase will consist of the equipment, inventory and 93,360-square-foot plant and land located in Greeneville, Tenn.
Circuit Systems said it would conclude the negotiations, complete the due diligence and close the deal as soon as possible. Terms were not disclosed.
The proposed agreement requires Philips Consumer Electronics to purchase all of its printed circuit board requirements for production of television sets in North America from Circuit Systems.

"This operation is price-competitive with the Far East and offers our customers several advantages such as location, response time and shipping costs," Circuit Systems President D.S. Patel said in a statement. "Even with our proposed agreement to produce PCBs (printed circuit boards) for Philips, there is significant additional capacity available to other current and prospective customers."
North America Philips is part of Philips Electronics NV .
